title: Product one-pager
description: Summarise a product or feature on one page for prospects and the sales team: the problem, who it is for, what it does today, proof and the next step.

inputs.label: Buyer and user roles the page addresses
Capabilities available in the released version, from the approved task
Customer results or measurements the team may quote

tool_actions.description: Publishing the one-pager on the website or in the sales tool.

sections.title: Problem
sections.prompt: The problem in the buyer's words and what it costs them today.

sections.title: Who it is for
sections.prompt: The roles and situations where the product fits, and where it does not.

sections.title: What it does
sections.prompt: Three to five capabilities available today, each tied to the problem.

sections.title: Why this rather than an alternative
sections.prompt: The difference with competitors and substitutes, from the market dossier.

sections.title: Proof
sections.prompt: Results, quotes or certifications, each with its source.

sections.title: Next step
sections.prompt: The one action a prospect takes next and who answers.

checks.verification: Every capability listed is available in the released version, not planned.
Each claim points to evidence the team can show: a measurement, a customer result or a dated source.
A salesperson used the page in a call or a rehearsal and their feedback is applied.
